explication: Ragas evaluates LLM applications with built-in LLM-based and traditional metrics, and can generate test data when none exists. Its runtime also provides model adapters, dataset handling, framework/observability integrations, and optimization-related components. The principal workflow is documented in the README; generation and several internal dependencies are supported by indexed source references. Unsampled evaluator, backend, and integration internals limit relationship detail, so uncertain links are omitted.
